title: Payments Desk Points of Judgement: Refund Base of a Cleaning and Damage Fees Level-Difference Refund
content:
**Rule.** The refund base of a Cleaning and Damage Fees level-difference refund depends on the refunds already made on the charge: when a level-difference refund was already made on it, the refund base is the fee charged less every refund already made on it, less the fee standing at the level moved to; when none was made and the fee charged differs from the flat fee of the level moved from, the refund base is the fee charged less the fee standing at the level moved to; otherwise the refund base is the level difference, that is the flat fee of the level moved from less the flat fee of the level moved to. The refund base is never below zero.

## Terms as the records show them

- **Fee charged** — the amount of the fee charge entry on the assessment ledger.
- **Refunds already made** — every partial refund and full refund already booked on that charge.
- **Level-difference refund already made** — a partial refund entry on the assessment ledger.
- **Fee standing at the level moved to** — the assessed fee on the assessment.
- **Level moved from** — the level of the latest level-difference refund on the charge, or the level the fee was charged at when none was made; its flat fee is one of Cleaning Fee Level 1 (Minor) $25.00, Cleaning Fee Level 2 (Moderate) $60.00, Cleaning Fee Level 3 (Significant) $100.00 and Cleaning Fee Level 4 (Major) $150.00.

## Branch table

| Level-difference refund already made on the charge | Fee charged compared with the flat fee of the level moved from | Refund base |
|---|---|---|
| yes | — | fee charged, less every refund already made, less the fee standing |
| no | different | fee charged less the fee standing |
| no | equal | flat fee of the level moved from less flat fee of the level moved to |

Each branch is floored at zero.

## Cases (hypothetical)

- Charged $172.50 at Cleaning Fee Level 4 (Major), no refund yet, fee standing $115.00: $172.50 differs from $150.00, so the base is $172.50 less $115.00, that is $57.50.
- Charged $150.00 at Level 4, no refund yet, now held at Cleaning Fee Level 3 (Significant): the charge equals the Level 4 flat fee, so the base is $150.00 less $100.00, that is $50.00.
- Charged $150.00, a level-difference refund of $50.00 already made, fee standing $60.00: $150.00 less $50.00 less $60.00, that is $40.00.
- Charged $150.00, a level-difference refund of $50.00 already made, fee standing $100.00: $150.00 less $50.00 less $100.00 is zero, so the base is $0.00.
